article.story: MOSCOW, Idaho -- — Money Williams' 35 points led Montana over Idaho 79-73 on Thursday. Williams added five assists for the Grizzlies (9-7, 3-0 Big Sky Conference). Te'Jon Sawyer went 7 of 10 from the field to add 16 points. Kenyon Aguino finished with 13 points. Jackson Rasmussen led the way for the Vandals (9-6, 1-1) with 16 points and seven rebounds. Brody Rowbury added 15 points and seven rebounds for Idaho. Isaiah Brickner had 14 points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
